resources.string: The phone restarted. Open Oigo and press the button. The microphone does not start by itself.
The microphone is not listening. Open the app and press the button.
Conversation mode. Say: Grok, and whatever you want to tell it. Or say: Grok, thanks, to close the conversation.
The phrase model could not be prepared
Press the button. Say “Grok,” and whatever you want to say.
New message from %1$s. If you want to hear it, say yes, after the tone.
New message from %1$s. Press listen and say yes, after the tone.
The notice from %1$s has no readable text.
There are no recent messages from %1$s.
All right. I will not read it.
The API key is missing. Open settings and paste the key from the xAI console.
Enter the API key in settings.
That option is off. Turn it on in settings if you want it.
That needs the contacts permission, and calls also need the phone permission.
I do not find a contact named %1$s.
%1$s has no phone marked as main.
WhatsApp is open with a draft for %1$s. You still press send.
WhatsApp is not available for that number.
Sending a Telegram message to a name is not available. Reading notices that arrived while the option was on still works.
Opens an email to antonio@castellon.ch with the report and the file. It is not sent by itself: you still send it. It does not include the key, message text, numbers, or names.
No app can send the report.
The official Grok app does not share its login. Paste a key from console.x.ai once. It stays on this phone.
Quiet minutes before the conversation closes
Off by default. A call needs contacts and the phone. A new message is announced, and the text is spoken only after you say yes. A send opens a draft. You press send in the other app.
The first launch does not record your voice. The key phrase is a written phoneme line, not a voice print.
That phoneme line is a candidate. It still needs a test on a real microphone. A noise gate can clip the start of a word.
Allow notification access so WhatsApp or Telegram notices can be seen.
Leaving battery optimization keeps the listening notification alive longer. If Android kills the process, the microphone stays off until you press the button.
For that long a short summary and the latest lines stay. Goodbye and silence close listening, not the day. «Grok, forget» clears the chat. Saved notes and alarms stay.
I cleared the chat. What I saved stays.
There is no room for another note. Delete one first.
I did not have that saved.
I will remind you around %1$s. If it is late, allow alarms for this app in the phone settings.
Tell me the time. For example: wake me at eight.
There are too many alarms. Cancel one first.
At %1$s, %2$s. If that is right, say grok, yes.
I would save: %1$s. If that is right, say grok, yes.
